tests.name: Default candidates retain M0-M3 and add the distinct gravity-plus-Magnus combination
Every pilot trial feeds exactly the same perturbed two-frame observations to every candidate
Independent assessment shares its own trials and freezes the pilot candidate selection
All attempted samples remain in state counts and observed-density denominators
Zero declared noise produces deterministic outcomes with no density or recommendation
Extreme incompatible observations never produce a forced winner
Variable candidate sets with identical presets and specified wind remain identical and ambiguous
M1 stores and independently reconstructs all six fitted kinematic quantities for every trial
Ranking and numerical dispersion do not depend on KDE bandwidth
Complete JSON export restores the sample ledger and every available density function
All failed fits remain in the full denominator and cannot become an empty conditional winner
Thrown solver failures and each nonarrival status are retained separately
Invalid smoothing floor is rejected before producing a recommendation
Configured minimum sample threshold prevents a small-sample unique recommendation
All three factories serialize together and preserve the paired random observations

policy.kind: predeclared operational stability rule, not proof of model truth
policy.intervalRule: Overlap of resampling intervals is a conservative ambiguity flag, not a significance test
policy.boundaryRule: Boundary counts are retained and warned; boundary-hit samples are not dropped

scope: Checks software comparison and all-trial bookkeeping, not physical validity or a uniquely correct force model.
